title: padus serotina var. asplenifolia
intro: Padus serotina var. asplenifolia, commonly known as Chokeberry, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to North America. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its high content of antioxidants and anthocyanins. The therapeutic actions of Chokeberry are attributed to its ability to inhibit platelet aggregation, lower blood pressure, and exhibit antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Chokeberry include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
